verdict.rationale: Mercury clearly supports creating multiple named checking accounts (mercury-cli exposes an 'accounts' resource; a 5-year customer describes 'dozens of purpose-named accounts with auto-funding rules'), suggesting auto-allocation of funds between sub-accounts is achievable. However, no official docs explicitly describe a built-in 'auto-allocate incoming deposits' feature — the evidence for automatic allocation comes only from a single community anecdote, not documented product capability.
